title: Schedule OpenAI Ads in ChatGPT by Hour | Campaign Hours
excerpt: Dayparting for OpenAI Ads in ChatGPT. Schedule campaigns by hour and day in your timezone, automate pauses and resumes, and review each action.
content_html:
Running OpenAI Ads in ChatGPT when your business is closed wastes budget. Use dayparting to schedule campaigns for the hours you can respond, or when your business customers are at work.

Example weekShorter Fridays

Campaign activeEurope/London

Match your ads to
your customers' day.

Build a weekly schedule around your opening hours or your business customers' working week.

Pause outside business hours

Set recurring pauses for evenings, weekends, or any hours you do not want your campaigns to run.

Follow your customers' timezone

Choose the timezone your customers work in. Schedules follow its daylight-saving changes automatically.

A record of each action

See requested pauses and resumes, their verification status, and any errors in Activity.

From account to
weekly schedule.

Three steps to put recurring campaign hours in place.

  1. 1

    Connect your ad account

    Add your account credentials and choose the campaigns you want to schedule.

  2. 2

    Set your run hours

    Pick the days, times, and timezone. Preview the week before enabling your schedule.

  3. 3

    Review the results

    Campaign Hours requests each pause and resume. Check Activity to see what was verified.

Start with three
schedules, free.
